The chart has two components that use `UserIcon`, both in an info tooltip that shows the orderer. Any behaviour change in `UserIcon` would reach both of them.

**Usages in openmrs-esm-patient-chart**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx`: `InfoTooltip` (lines 376-382) renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside an `IconButton` whose label is the orderer. The icon is imported at line 48.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx`: `InfoTooltip` (lines 105-117) renders `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a `ToggletipButton`, with the orderer in the `Toggletip` content. The icon is imported at line 5.

Both usages pass only `size`, so a change to how `UserIcon` handles its props or rendering would affect them directly. A change to its label or accessibility output would also show up in these tooltips.

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` (lines 824-828): the real component, a `memo(forwardRef(...))` wrapper around `Icon` with `icon="omrs-icon-user"`. This is the code that would change.

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/variables/UserIcon.md` (line 3): generated API docs.
